failure.error: 2026/09/20 21:21:06 [emerg] 1#1: host not found in upstream "aibim" in /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf:46
failure.cause: admin/frontend/nginx.conf:44-46 declares a /ws/ location with `proxy_pass http://aibim:8080;`. nginx resolves upstream host names at config load, so it aborts. The `aibim` app-backend service is never started by `make admin-dev` (Makefile:582-583 starts only admin-backend, admin-frontend, postgres), so the name does not exist on the fce9_default network.

prediction_outcome.as_issued: falsified on the first clause: make admin-dev starts postgres and admin-backend but the admin-frontend crash-loops (nginx cannot resolve the aibim upstream) so the surface is not reachable
prediction_outcome.after_bridge: the second and third clauses hold: the surface rendered with real data and C7 appears at 320 and 768 with 13 ui-observed rows
prediction_outcome.consequence_for_the_line: the second stack's corpus CAN carry the classes the first one did, but the boot path is not self-sufficient, so E9 must record the frontend crash-loop and the 502 ticket route as part of the method, not as an environment accident.
